response.sql: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length FROM film GROUP BY rating HAVING COUNT(length) > 0), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS baseline_length FROM rating_averages), above_baseline AS (SELECT ra.avg_length FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE ra.avg_length > b.baseline_length), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS kept_avg_length FROM above_baseline) SELECT AVG(ab.avg_length) AS mean_length, AVG(ab.avg_length - b.baseline_length) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(ab.avg_length - km.kept_avg_length) AS mean_above_kept_mean FROM above_baseline ab CROSS JOIN baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean km WHERE ab.avg_length > km.kept_avg_length;
